methods.label: Check the circle definitions
methods.explanation: A diameter is a chord passing through the center and is the longest chord in a circle. A semicircle is a special type of arc; not every arc is a semicircle. Circles with equal radii are congruent circles and are not necessarily concentric.
methods.levelReason: Uses only the circle concepts introduced at the stated Grade 9 level.
